records.comment: He is a natural leader, but she tends to get emotional in meetings and should be coached on staying calm.
At his age it is hard to expect him to pick up the new tooling; a younger digital native would adapt faster.
Great delivery this quarter. Handles ambiguity well and mentors junior colleagues.
With two small kids at home, I assumed she would not want the on-call rotation, so I did not offer it.
His accent makes client calls difficult; we should staff someone who sounds more local.
Seems to be from a rough background, so polish in executive settings will take time.
Needs to dress more professionally and watch his weight if he wants to be client-facing.
